title: Make the webkit-verify lab focus-ring probes enforcing after one green production deploy
evidence: From PR 1724 (H89, US-62 AC10b). tools/webkit-focus-probes.mjs: probeLabFocusRing (a lab test's Add form, Value then Tab into Date) and probeDateCellRing (the blood table's New date cell) are advisory: they print 'ADVISORY ... verified' or 'ADVISORY ... failed' and never throw. Once one Deploy run's verify-live prints both 'verified' lines on iPhone 13, iPhone SE, desktop 1440 and desktop 1200, make them throw like probeFocusRing (H90, PR 1704): drop the try/catch around the asserts (keep the back-to-My-health step), update tools/webkit-verify.test.ts to pin the throw and the non-zero exit, and remove TODO(H110) in tools/webkit-verify.mjs. (H110)
